en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a countryside church with a rectangular nave and a square tower topped by a small cupola. The church is surrounded by a tree‑lined cemetery with orderly rows of graves. Nearby are a few small buildings and a road intersection. In the background there are open fields, a forest, a lake or river shoreline, and a larger institutional‑looking brick building set among trees. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
